decisions.statement: A subagent is not a seat.
A subagent's page is there while the subagent runs.
A subagent's page goes when the subagent returns.
A page waits on what its subagent left running rather than on that subagent returning.
A page goes whether or not the subagent left edits waiting beside it.
The edits a subagent leaves unlanded move onto the seat that dispatched it as its page goes.
The readings a subagent made move onto that seat as its unlanded edits do.
A subagent whose page comes back out of history takes those readings back.
A page for a subagent that is no longer running goes.
A page is written again out of history when the subagent it was for is next dispatched or resumed.
A subagent the transcript names nowhere is done for now rather than done for good.
A resumed subagent may be named nowhere by the transcript while it is working.
A subagent's page goes once rather than going, coming back, and going again.
A subagent begins a turn before the landing writing its page has gone.
The stretch a subagent has no page for has run to minutes rather than to seconds.
Nothing tells a subagent its page is back but a call that stops being refused.
A subagent at work with no page is found by nothing.
A subagent whose page has gone can report and can keep no edit, so it can land nothing.
A read waits for the subagent's page rather than answering a body recorded nowhere.
A subagent whose page never lands within that wait is refused its read as well.
A subagent can ask what it is leaving behind when its page has gone.
A commit a subagent lands is no evidence the reading of whether it works consults.
A subagent whose page went while it worked takes that page back without help from outside.
A subagent's slug is the name of the seat that ran the subagent and the id the subagent runs under.
The id a subagent runs under is the part of its slug after its seat's name.
A subagent's own id is minted rather than taken from the id the subagent acts under.
A subagent states the assignment its seat states.
A subagent states no persona.
A subagent states no role.
A subagent states no person.
A subagent may have fewer tools than the seat that ran that subagent.
A message to a subagent arrives at its next tool round.
A message to a subagent dies with the session that had the message.
A subagent keeps edits only while the index files its seat by id and its own page by slug.
A subagent has no process of its own for a stop to end.
A subagent is stopped by refusing the model turns that subagent asks for.
A stop reaches a subagent at its next model turn rather than at once.
A subagent stopped from the agents panel has its page taken away.
The page goes as the refused turn ends the subagent rather than before.
A subagent that asks for no further turn has its page taken by the sweep.
The sweep judges a stopped page stale on the stop rather than on a reading.
A stopped subagent a live process acts under keeps its page until that ends.
A service runs that sweep on a timer, so such a page waits at most one tick.
A stop censuses the page first, and takes it at once where it is already stale.
A stop outlives the page that stop was written beside.
A stop outlives that page only in the proxy that had already read the stop.

definition: an agent a seat runs with the Agent tool
